test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 15 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which country has been elected as the president of International Solar Alliance (ISA) in October 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 3**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India and France** were re-elected as the **president and co-president of the International Solar Alliance (ISA) **for a term of two years at the virtual meeting of the third assembly.
 
• A total of 53 member countries and 5 signatory and prospective member countries participated in the assembly.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• At the virtual meeting of the third assembly, the **International Solar Alliance (ISA) **appointed four new **Vice-Presidents** to represent different regions.
 
• The Asia Pacific Region was represented by **Fiji and Nauru**, while Mauritius and Niger represented the Africa Region.
 
• **The Europe** and others Region had representatives from the** UK and Netherlands,** and the** Latin America and Caribbean Region** was represented by Cuba and Guyana.
 
• These **Vice-Presidents** assumed their positions. During the assembly, the initiatives of the ISA Secretariat to establish the Coalition for Sustainable Climate Action (CSCA) and enhance engagement with the private and public corporate sector were approved.
 
• As a significant step, ten public sector organizations in India presented a cheque of 1 million USD each to support these initiatives at the assembly.
